Return one 1024 x 1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent background, in the identical full square canvas as the guide, unresized. The object occupies only x=322 through 701 and y=283 through 740 in the 1024 square. KEEP the large transparent margins: do not enlarge, recenter, shift, rotate, zoom or crop. No new geometry or silhouette protrusions. Do not change the visible shapes or their arrangement. This is a surface-colour edit of the existing guide, not a new interpretation of the spire.

Paint the guide's surfaces with the materials and colours of design_reference.png: black-violet purple resin and chitin, ivory bone spikes, dim glowing orange inside hollow broken ends. The resin is glossy as a material, but render its BASE COLOUR without reflections or strong specular highlights. Preserve the material detail and restrained colours of the approved design while following the actual guide geometry. Colour glowing orange regions at their emissive colour without any light spill onto their surroundings.

LIGHTING: TEXTURE SOURCE / ALBEDO. Even flat shadowless illumination from the viewer. Every surface clearly readable. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional shading, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light, no bloom or glow halo. No background, no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no labels or watermarks. Keep the guide silhouette, size, position and every shape edge unchanged; replace only the grey surface appearance.
